summary: Segmented, localized time field (12/24-hour) with limits and validation.
whenToUse: Times without a date (opening time, daily reminder).
whenNotToUse: Date and time together: use DateTimePicker.
Choosing from regular slots in a list: use TimePicker.
Durations: use NumberInput with a unit.

props.name: hourCycle
props.description: Forces the format; by default it depends on the locale.

inherits: Props of react-aria-components TimeField (name, validate, hideTimeZone…).
accessibility: Each segment is a spinbutton with a name (hour, minutes) and a text value.
responsive: Fluid width; segments have a sufficient touch area.
customization: className and style on the field.
commonMistakes: Storing the time as a Date: use Time.toString() (HH:mm:ss).
